_about: Memento tier map. `policy` is the agent-agnostic contract: ranks, roles, named agents and the justification rule. `bindings` hold what each agent runtime needs to enforce it (today: claude-code). Owned by the framework canon; each instance carries a byte-identical copy that its doctor hash-checks. Human-edited, John-verified. Read by memento/tools/agent-tier-gate.py and memento/tools/generate_agents.py. Nothing outside a binding's ladder is ever allowed. See plan-spawn-tier-control-across-estates-2026-09-06.

judgement.note: the main thread; any spawn resolving to a frontier rank, named agent or not, needs a justification line

memento-scout.description: Read-only evidence gatherer for Memento-governed work. Use for multi-file recon, large log/test-output scanning, repo pattern searches, and doc/capability extraction. Returns concise cited findings; never edits, never decides.

enforced: no edit or write tools (it carries no agent memory, which would add Write and Edit)
behavioural: never decides; returns evidence and declines verdicts

memento-implementer.description: Bounded implementer for Memento-governed work. Use ONLY with a settled spec (files, exact changes, verification steps). Makes the specified changes, verifies, reports a contract; never expands scope, never makes design decisions, never commits.

behavioural: never commits or pushes (it has a shell; this is compliance, not a boundary)

memento-reviewer.description: Adversarial reviewer for Memento-governed work. Use before presenting an artefact or diff to John. Isolated context, assumes failure, demands forensic evidence; reviews against spec and Memento principles; PASS/NEEDS-CHANGES verdict with evidence.

behavioural: edits and writes nothing (its agent memory makes the runtime add Write and Edit to its tools: toggle test on CLI 2.1.286, 2026-10-06)
read-only via the shell (it has Bash to run witnesses and tests; a shell can write, so this is compliance, not a boundary)
never a fork of the presenting session (the spawner's discipline; the gate treats forks as inherits)

claude-code.hook_fields: PreToolUse. Agent: tool_input.model, tool_input.subagent_type, tool_input.prompt. Workflow: tool_input.script | scriptPath | name.
claude-code.runtime_dependency: tool_input.model on the Agent tool is not listed in hooks.md. The synthetic witness builds its own payloads, so it cannot detect the live runtime ceasing to deliver the field. A live-dispatch witness checks that: a real Agent call with model=haiku whose log line must appear. It is re-run after every harness upgrade before verified_against moves; last passed on CLI 2.1.296, 2026-10-10.
claude-code.aliases_source: model-config.md: aliases point to the recommended version for the provider and update over time
